Xech X-Charge Power Bank Fast Charging – Compact, Portable & High-Capacity

Stay powered throughout the day with the Xech X-Charge Power Bank Fast Charging, designed for users who need speed, reliability, and portability in one compact device. Built with a high-capacity 10000mAh lithium polymer battery, this power bank delivers efficient and safe charging for smartphones, tablets, earbuds, smartwatches, and other USB-powered devices. Whether you are traveling, commuting, or working remotely, the Xech X-Charge ensures uninterrupted power anytime, anywhere.

The Xech X-Charge Power Bank Fast Charging supports advanced fast-charging protocols with a powerful USB-C output of up to 20W / 22.5W, enabling quicker top-ups compared to standard power banks. With support for both USB-C and Micro USB input, it offers flexible recharging options, making it compatible with a wide range of chargers and cables.

Fast Charging Performance You Can Trust

Equipped with USB-C input voltage of 5V/3A and 9V/2A and Micro USB input voltage of 5V/2A and 9V/2A, the Fast Charging reduces charging time significantly. The intelligent power management system automatically detects connected devices and delivers optimal power output for safe and efficient charging.

With 2 x USB-A ports and 1 x USB-C port, this fast charging allows you to charge up to three devices simultaneously. Whether you are charging an Android smartphone, iPhone, Bluetooth headset, or power-hungry gadgets, the delivers consistent performance without overheating.

Compact, Portable & Travel-Friendly Design

Designed for everyday convenience, the features a sleek and compact body with dimensions of 13.5cm x 6.6cm x 1.5cm. Weighing only 225g, it easily fits into your pocket, backpack, or travel pouch, making it ideal for office use, outdoor activities, and long journeys.

The durable outer casing protects the internal components, while the premium build quality ensures long-lasting performance. This lightweight fast charging is perfect for users who need power on the go without carrying bulky accessories.

  • Battery Type: Lithium Polymer
  • USB-C Output Wattage: 20W / 22.5W fast charging

  • Output Ports: 2 x USB-A + 1 x USB-C
  • Dimensions: 13.5cm x 6.6cm x 1.5cm
  • Net Weight: 225g
